name: Security
summary: Watch the security of the servers and sites you own — scans, findings and a server overview.
description: One place for the security of what you own. Add a server or a site you own and Security checks its open ports and services, TLS and certificate, security headers and CORS, and firewall behaviour, then lists findings with evidence and a fix hint and lets you retest. A self-audit checks this Girru’s own headers, sign-in and rate limits. Campaigns repeat a check on a schedule and track its score over time. Defensive only: it tests owned or authorized targets, never attacks, and never scans anything you have not added. Replaces the separate Server Monitor and WAF Security previews.
permissions: Scans only the servers and sites you add and confirm you own or may test
Refuses local and private network addresses unless you allow them in Settings
Keeps your assets, findings, evidence and campaigns in its own tables
Runs your scheduled campaigns in the background
Sends requests to this Girru’s own address when you run a self-audit
Adds a waf_scan tool your agents can use once you allow them
